about: Per palette slot: the preview's flat render (base colour as emission, no light) against the palette (8-bit sRGB), on pixels with no ink, no dot, away from edges (the index pass); and the approved toon render of the same camera at those pixels: share within 6/255 of the palette colour times each cel band (1.0 lit, 0.70, 0.40), and its median linear ratio to the palette.
